svg.title: F07-4 Intervention matrix: which party holds, witnesses or reviews each type of ITP activity
svg.text: F07-4 Intervention matrix: which party holds, witnesses or reviews each type of ITP activity
MSC-1 quality plan defaults · SC performs every line · H stops work until written release · W proceeds after notice · R reviews records within 5 working days · S samples without notice
• Covered work, first energisation and first fill are hold points for the Engineer; first energisation and first fill are also holds for the CxM.
• Statutory and OEM warranty points are held by the authority or the OEM; "Ready for L3" is held by the CxM.
F07-4 · Intervention matrix: which party holds, witnesses or reviews each type of ITP activity
Data Centre Commissioning Field Manual R01 EN · October 2026 · educational reference, not to scale · project and OEM documents govern
Symbols: QElectroTech EN 60617 and P&ID collections, CC-BY 3.0, native geometry · instrument bubbles per ISA 5.1 · states per IEC 60617 / IEEE C37.2 practice
